dedupe_keys.name: tidal stream site agreements england wales ni the crown estate

description: The Crown Estate publishes tidal-stream site agreements in English, Welsh and Northern Irish waters. The description says boundaries reflect signed Agreements for Lease and Lease documents. They define agreed seabed areas, not installed turbine positions, generation capacity or evidence of operation. Export-cable agreements are a separate resource. The spatial agreements can delimit development scenarios only when their planning and operational status are checked separately. Coverage is English, Welsh and Northern Irish waters. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source offers data free of charge under Crown Estate GIS terms, with attribution, distribution and resale restrictions. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the other Crown Estate wind, tidal and wave agreement layers reviewed in the Thames Estuary catalogue.
